{{Top|leg}}
An '''adrenaline patch''' was a medical tool used to administer [[Adrenaline/Legends|adrenaline]] to a patient via the neck. [[Maglenna Pendower]] used one in conjunction with a [[pressure resuscitator]] and an [[adhesive defib strip]] to save the life of [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]].<ref name="DP">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>
